author: More Perfect Union
description:
A staggering 18.3 million children who used to qualify for free or reduced lunch no longer get these meals at school, thanks to the One Big Beautiful Bill.

We're starting to see the disastrous effects of this legislation rammed through by Trump and the GOP.

Millions are losing SNAP and going hungry. Millions will lose healthcare. People already can't afford the basics of life, and the Republican government deliberately made life even more difficult and unaffordable for people across America.
title: These companies got massive tax breaks — while their workers go hungry

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Josh Kushner, not Jared, was actually the first billionaire Kushner.

Corporate media loves to describe him as a liberal, but he's actually a vulture venture capitalist who created a healthcare company with the highest denial rates of any ACA insurer.

He's also a slum lord, an AI weapons investor, and now the new owner of the Lakers.

Producer: Meagan Day
Editor: @discosludge
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: What the 'Good' Kushner Brother Doesn’t Want You to Know

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Major League Baseball owners now get paid more to have a losing team.

We investigated the playbook that allows teams like the Marlins and Pirates to rake in the largest sums of cash while paying players the least.

Billionaires win no matter what while fans lose out.
